researchResult.evidence.measureGeometry: Spherical area/length estimate; not a cadastral or engineering survey.

researchResult.evidence.straightLine: Straight-line distance: {meters} m; not walking distance

researchResult.evidence.none: No spatial scope could be confirmed for this step; the current view is not used as a substitute.

researchResult.evidence.errGeneric: This step wasn't completed ({code}); that doesn't mean there is no data, and zero is not substituted.
researchResult.evidence.formulaNote: Difference = this area − baseline; relative to baseline = this area ÷ baseline.

researchResult.nearby.timeNote: Data date / full coverage: not confirmed. Read time {time} is not the data's update time.
